competition_track: NASA Space Apps Challenge - Planetary Data & Human Exploration
target_audience: Kids ages 7-12, Educators, and Space Enthusiasts

core_tradeoff_mechanics.system: Power vs Life Support vs Heating
core_tradeoff_mechanics.tradeoff_rule: Solar energy is only generated during daylight (Sol 06:00 to 18:00). At night, temperatures plunge to -105°C, demanding heavy battery heating load. Blackouts cause immediate hypothermia and habitat degradation.
core_tradeoff_mechanics.nasa_grounding: NASA InSight TWINS Diurnal Thermal Archive (10.17189/1518950)

core_tradeoff_mechanics.system: Space Radiation Shielding vs Crew Energy
core_tradeoff_mechanics.tradeoff_rule: Cosmic rays penetrate metal hulls. Shoveling Martian regolith dirt shields the dome (-40% radiation exposure), but increases crew fatigue (+14) and drains power.
Earth is 140 million miles away. Radio waves take 14 minutes one-way. Houston cannot rescue astronauts in real-time; players must make autonomous mission decisions.
core_tradeoff_mechanics.nasa_grounding: NASA Deep Space Network (DSN) & Mars Relay Operations

core_tradeoff_mechanics.system: Subsurface Ice Hydrology vs Scientific Triangulation
core_tradeoff_mechanics.tradeoff_rule: Drilling into the -38m ice table provides life-giving potable water (+180L). Diverting sensors to triangulate deep acoustic anomalies yields breakthrough science discoveries (+550 XP), but expends 25 kWh of battery buffer.
core_tradeoff_mechanics.nasa_grounding: NASA SWIM Subsurface Water Ice Mapping (10.17189/1519789) & MRO SHARAD (10.17189/1520638)

core_tradeoff_mechanics.tradeoff_rule: Coronal Mass Ejections cause Solar Energetic Particle (SEP) storms spiking surface radiation to 1.15 mSv/h. Astronauts must abort EVAs and seek shelter.
core_tradeoff_mechanics.nasa_grounding: NASA Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information (DONKI)

core_tradeoff_mechanics.tradeoff_rule: Sleep deprivation and high workload reduce crew vitals. Rest cycles in habitat consume food and water rations to restore cognitive performance and physical health.
core_tradeoff_mechanics.nasa_grounding: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) Astronaut Health & Circadian Studies
